running_thesis: Friday 20 Nov (Cboe) was the deepest leg yet: S&P 500 and Dow in correction, the Nasdaq Composite down 5.3%, and the Nasdaq 100 near bear territory. Nvidia fell nearly 14% on SEC accounting-probe reports and Anthropic fell more than 9%. VIX 35.89, VXN 45.25, COR1M 36.05, VVIX 138.03: contagion is broad. Yields fell sharply (10-year 4.92%) as a flight to safety, while a 9 Dec hike is priced (Polymarket 25 bps 92.5%). HY OAS 3.52 as of 19 Nov. Unverified headlines point to a Monday bounce. ANT options start 23 Nov. Oil data stale to 17 Nov.
open_questions: Does a Monday bounce hold, or is this a bear-market leg?
Does the Nvidia SEC probe spread to other chipmakers (AMD allegations are open)?
Do credit spreads keep widening after four straight wider prints to 19 Nov?
Do 50+ bps hike odds rise again before 9 Dec, or does the equity damage soften the Fed?
